audit.limits: Only visible accepted holder changes, at most one per task. Fresh task permutations within a single scheduling entry are not observable. Physical distances use exact unweighted BFS and compare both holders at the same decision. The prospective p90 uses exact physical first-admission bounds and completed single-holder tasks before the decision, so it is not the production cached/mixed estimator. No counterfactual movement, completion gain, complete matching-cycle account or throughput upper bound.
